name: PeriTriaxController
description:
Engine for independently controlling stress or strain in periodic simulations.

 PeriTriaxController.goal contains absolute values for the controlled quantity, and PeriTriaxController.stressMask determines meaning of those values (0 for strain, 1 for stress): e.g. ``( 1<<0 | 1<<2 ) = 1 | 4 = 5``...

attributes.name: dynCell
attributes.description: Imposed stress can be controlled using the packing stiffness (dynCell = False) or by applying the laws of dynamic (dynCell=true). Don't forget to assign a

attributes.name: goal
attributes.description:
Desired stress or strain values (depending on stressMask), strains defined as ``strain(i)=log(Fii)`` with ``Fii`` the cell transformation matrix.

.. warning:: Strains are relative to the

attributes.name: stressMask
attributes.description: mask determining strain/stress (0/1) meaning for goal components

attributes.name: maxStrainRate
attributes.description: Maximum strain rate of the periodic cell.

attributes.name: maxUnbalanced
attributes.description: maximum unbalanced force.

attributes.name: absStressTol
attributes.description: Absolute stress tolerance with respect to ``goal``.

attributes.name: relStressTol
attributes.description: Relative stress tolerance with respect to ``goal``.

attributes.name: growDamping
attributes.description: Damping of cell resizing (0=perfect control, 1=no control at all); see also ``wallDamping`` in

attributes.name: globUpdate
attributes.description: How often to recompute average stress, stiffness and unbalaced force.

attributes.name: doneHook
attributes.description: python command to be run when the desired state is reached

attributes.name: maxBodySpan
attributes.description: maximum body dimension |ycomp|

attributes.name: stressTensor
attributes.description: average stresses, updated at every step (only every globUpdate steps recomputed from interactions if !dynCell)

attributes.name: stress
attributes.description: diagonal terms of the stress tensor

attributes.name: strain
attributes.description: Cell true strain |yupdate|

attributes.name: strainRate
attributes.description: cell strain rate |yupdate|

attributes.name: stiff
attributes.description: average stiffness (only every globUpdate steps recomputed from interactions) |yupdate|

attributes.name: currUnbalanced
attributes.description: current unbalanced force (updated every globUpdate) |yupdate|

attributes.name: prevGrow
attributes.description: previous cell grow

attributes.name: mass
attributes.description: mass of the cell (user set); if not set and dynCell is used, it will be computed as sum of masses of all particles.

attributes.name: externalWork
attributes.description: Work input from boundary controller.

attributes.name: dead
attributes.description: If true, this engine will not run at all; can be used for making an engine temporarily deactivated and only resurrect it at a later point.

attributes.name: ompThreads
attributes.description: Number of threads to be used in the engine. If ompThreads<0 (default), the number will be typically OMP_NUM_THREADS or the number N defined by 'yade -jN' (this behavior can depend on the engine though). This attribute will only affect engines whose code includes openMP parallel regions (e.g. InteractionLoop). This attribute is mostly useful for experiments or when combining ParallelEngine with engines that run parallel regions, resulting in nested OMP loops with different number of threads at each level.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Textual label for this object; must be valid python identifier, you can refer to it directly from python.

attributes.name: execTime
attributes.description: Cumulative time in nanoseconds this Engine took to run (only used if O.timingEnabled == ``True``).

attributes.name: execCount
attributes.description: Cumulative count this engine was run (only used if O.timingEnabled == ``True``).

attributes.name: timingDeltas
attributes.description: Detailed information about timing inside the Engine itself. Empty unless enabled in the source code and O.timingEnabled == ``True``.
